description: This file contains the implementation of a RecyclerView Adapter named SavedCouponsAdapter, which manages a list of coupon codes in a saved coupons feature within an Android Kotlin frontend. It handles binding coupon data to UI elements and user interactions such as selection and removal of coupons.

classes.name: SavedCouponsAdapter
classes.description: An adapter managing a list of coupon codes, providing binding logic with a layout and handling user interactions.

classes.name: SavedCouponsAdapter.VH
classes.description: ViewHolder inner class used by SavedCouponsAdapter to hold and bind UI components for each coupon item.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Updates the list of coupons and refreshes the RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a ViewHolder for it.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of coupons in the list.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a coupon code to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: VH.bind
methods.description: Binds a coupon code to UI elements and sets up click listeners for selection and removal.
